findings.conclusion: The four inspected cells have correct native/sim token counts and compatible engine boundary definitions; no evidence of skipped prompt tokens or client time substituted for engine time.
findings.evidence: native raw timestamp/count rows and simulator batch items
findings.limit: Native ubatch counters are not retained; only within-request durations can be compared across different native/simulator clock epochs

findings.conclusion: All four frozen configurations explicitly record compiled_cuda_graphs=false. Missing CUDA Graph replay is not supported as the explanation.
findings.limit: CPU-side graph reuse/planning is a separate behavior; do not conflate it with CUDA Graph replay

findings.conclusion: Kernel launches are already charged, while separately calibrated synchronize/phase/startup additions are unavailable.
findings.evidence: positive gpu0.frontend busy service plus frozen GPUProfile and calibration source
findings.limit: launch busy time, host API wall and GPU kernel time are different overlapping domains

findings.conclusion: For C1/P512 with cache_n=0 and b=ub=64, 8 prompt chunks is the source-consistent expectation and matches sim. C4 mixed batches have reduced prompt rows after decode occupancy; ceil(P/64) per slot is only a lower bound.
findings.evidence: P512 counts; C4 per-slot item sizes preserved
findings.limit: Native log files contain zero bytes, so actual physical ubatch/kernel cadence is unknown

findings.conclusion: R6 source MMQ cost coverage is narrow for Qwen2.5 and not the dominant low-M decode treatment. Qwen2.5 static tensors include Q5_0/Q8_0 K896, while source cost requires K%256==0; many calls explicitly fall back.
findings.limit: These are pre-repair simulator ledger counts, not native dispatch or ground-truth kernel counts

findings.conclusion: The residual cannot yet be apportioned between actual submit cadence/sync, unsupported MMVQ/nonaligned shapes, graph planning and cache conversion, or residency/split behavior.
findings.evidence: source eligibility gaps and missing native physical events
findings.limit: Do not regress LLM residuals into a launch constant, throughput multiplier, per-token fixed cost or model-specific correction

minimum_general_microbenchmarks.item: Direct-submit GGML boundary and supply cadence
minimum_general_microbenchmarks.design: One independent GGML graph, direct CUDA build, same runtime DLL identities; distinguish repeated kernel enqueue, host-paced enqueue and only-real-boundary synchronization. Record QPC enqueue/sync/total wall and CUDA event interval; separate already-overlapped GPU execution.
minimum_general_microbenchmarks.why: The existing 16 launch-probe configurations are all unresolved and supply mode changes wall time strongly.
minimum_general_microbenchmarks.acceptance: Stable independent shape/session holdout, documented clock/thermal regime and resource-domain boundary; no automatic transfer of empty-kernel constants

minimum_general_microbenchmarks.item: MMVQ low-M and K896 ordinary quantized matmul
minimum_general_microbenchmarks.design: Synthetic Q5_0/Q8_0 at K896 with representative N128/N896/N4864, and Q4_K/Q6_K at aligned dimensions; M1/2/4 plus M64 control. Use explicit valid buffer layout and source dispatch qualification; retain correct numerical output and actual selected kernel names when compatible trace is available.
minimum_general_microbenchmarks.why: Qwen2.5 K896 exclusions and both models low-M mmvq_precedes_mmq leave the generic fallback dominant.
minimum_general_microbenchmarks.acceptance: Source-derived operation/bytes model and separate evaluation on unseen synthetic dimensions, never LLM wall-time fitting

minimum_general_microbenchmarks.item: Conversion/cache writeback and graph split boundary
minimum_general_microbenchmarks.design: Synthetic GET_ROWS and transposed KV/cache conversion plus CPU-to-GPU and logits return boundaries with recorded index geometry. Measure isolated conversion and dependency chain separately.
minimum_general_microbenchmarks.why: Conversion arithmetic and true index/cache transactions are explicitly unpriced; number and location of native backend synchronizations are not yet observed.
minimum_general_microbenchmarks.acceptance: Do not sum nested API wait + kernel union; unsupported layout remains uncovered rather than forced into an average term
